masjidFeatures.title: Daily Prayers
masjidFeatures.description: Our Masjid hosts the five daily prayers, providing a spiritual home for worship and reflection, with a dedicated space for women.

masjidFeatures.title: Community Engagement
masjidFeatures.description: We organize cultural events and outreach programs to build bridges and foster positive integration within the community.

masjidDonationMessage:
Your support matters.
By contributing, you help create a welcoming space for prayer, learning, and kindness that serves the local community.

ramadanFeaturesCards.title: Prayer Times
ramadanFeaturesCards.description:
• Isha & Taraweeh: Isha prayer is fixed at 20:30, followed immediately by Taraweeh.
  • Last 10 Nights (Qiyam/Tahajjud): Special late-night prayers from 23:30 – 00:30 nightly.
  • Attendance: Taraweeh and Tahajjud are available for both men and women.

ramadanFeaturesCards.title: Community & Support
ramadanFeaturesCards.description:
• Limited Capacity: Masjid space is limited. Attendance is on a first-come, first-served basis.
  • Parking & Transport: Local attendees are strongly encouraged to walk. For those coming from a distance, please carpool with neighbors to accommodate limited parking.
